findings.title: Quote PDF route returns another tenant's quote
findings.description:
Unverified variant of sarif-8fbfc6dbb67477650d1c8f305e9da7608d1e3ef3fafd034142d2a8b3d4c2ca79-526ff360b63f93e7b3b23e9c: Any signed-in user can read any tenant's invoice by id. GET /api/invoices/:id returned any tenant's invoice to any signed-in user because the route loaded the record with the unscoped invoiceRepo.findById(id) and never compared its orgId with the caller's. The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C25)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it, so its severity is capped at medium (the thread said high). Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

An authenticated caller can request a quote PDF by ID. The route uses an unscoped quote lookup and renders the quote's contents, including internal notes, without checking ownership.

Suggested fix: Use `quoteRepo.findForOrg(req.user!.orgId, req.params.id)` before rendering the PDF.

The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C15)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it. Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

The reminder job loads an invoice using only `job.payload.invoiceId` and then composes a message from its customer, lines, and totals. The `orgId` use only scopes the customer lookup after the invoice has already been selected.

Suggested fix: Require a trusted job tenant ID and use `invoiceRepo.findForOrg(job.orgId, job.payload.invoiceId)` before composing the reminder.

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it. Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

The route accepts any invoice ID and globally loads and returns the invoice. It is mounted behind shared service-token middleware, so this is a privileged internal access path rather than access by an ordinary signed-in tenant user.

Suggested fix: If internal callers must be tenant-scoped, require an authorised org ID and use invoiceRepo.findForOrg; otherwise document and constrain the service-token trust boundary.
